method: Best base stat among gear obtainable at that rank (drop source text on each item page). Weapons: highest Attack among the class's weapon styles (ties: crit chance). Armor: highest HP (ties: damage reduction); the site does not tag armor types on item pages, so armor is not filtered by class. Base values are rank E / Common / +0; the real value scales with rank, grade and forge (see Items and forge formulas).
